about: Offline Hyperliquid unified-account run through the published npm packages: the SDK's exported entry point, the shipped candle CLI and the shipped candle-mcp server, each installed at an exact pin. Every address, balance and position is made up and time is fixed. API and Hyperliquid /info answers are in-memory stand-ins; nothing is signed, submitted or sent to a venue.
